story.title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon

draft:
I'm intrigued by AMD's acquisition of Taalas, which promises to boost inference performance by etching models into silicon. 
This approach could significantly reduce latency and increase efficiency. 
Key benefits include improved performance and reduced power consumption. 
Will this technology become a new standard for AI hardware? 
#AI #Inference #SiliconETCHING
